content: Adam yesuru Eva titap pa tovaaŋ

Moot inepneep izi uum paam. Ye le ŋgar tiina kat pa ghamuuŋ kaarom ilib pa ŋgai tisob to Maaron Yoova ighur di. Sawa eez, ye ighason liva ighaze: “Vena? Ai anoŋadi naol to tineep ila uum lolo, Maaron Yoova iŋgalsekin gham padi ighaze aghan di malep. Nene onoon?” Yo 8:44; Syg 12:9, 20:2
Liva ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Maau. Maaron isaav ighaze: Ai naol to tiyoon ila uum lolo, yei irau nighan anoŋadi le tisob.
Ai ee moghon kat to iyoon ila bodbodaaŋ to uum, tauto ye iŋgalsekin ghei pani ighaze nighani malep, ve nikisi malep. Pasa, ighaze nighani, ma nikisi, nene pale nimaat.”

Moot isaav pani muul ighaze: “Maau. Yamru irau amaat maau. Maaron iwatag: Ighaze yamru aghan ai tonowen anoŋa, nene pale matamim pakia ve ŋgar tiam ighazooŋ, le anim ye tau, ve aghilaal ŋgar poia ve ŋgar samia.”

Liva ighita ai anoŋa tonowen paghuna kat pa mata ve poia pa ghaniiŋ paam. Ye lolo pani kat pasa, ighaze ai anoŋa tonenen pale igham ŋgar toni ighazooŋ. Tovenen ighami ve ighani, ve igham pida pa azuwa ve ana ighan paam. 2Kor 11:3; 1Tim 2:14
Yesuru tighani le isob, ghoro matadi pakia ve tighilaal tighaze tinidi ŋginiŋa. Tovenen yesuru tila tigham ai raua ve tidagini, ve tipoon di pani.
Rabrab izi ve ndug iluum, ghoro yesuru tilooŋ Maaron Yoova ilaghlaagh ila uum lolo. Tovenen tila tiyooŋ pani ila ai lolo.
Maaron ipoi tamoot ighaze: “Ou, taum sine?”
Tamoot ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “You nalooŋ aghem avolutu ila uum lolo, tovenen namatughez payom ve nayooŋ. Pasa, tinig ŋginiŋa.”
Tovenen Maaron ighasoni ighaze: “Sei isaav payom ighaze tinim ŋginiŋa? Ai to you naŋgalsekin ghom pani, yom avaat ughan anoŋa eta wa.”
Tamoot ipamuul Maaron aliŋa ighaze: “You maau. Liva to yom ugham payou ughaze yeru nineep, tauto igham ai tonowen anoŋa pida payou ve naghani.”
Tovenen Maaron Yoova isaav pa liva ana ighaze: “Yom ugham ŋgar tonene pasa?” Liva ipamuul Maaron aliŋa ighaze: “You maau. Moot itombaan ghou, tauto naghani.”
Maaron ighur atia pa tamtoghon toman moot
Tovenen Maaron Yoova isaav pa moot ighaze:

content.text: “Yom to unum pughu pa sosor tonene.
Tauto pataŋani tiina kat pale iza tiom ilib pa ŋgai tisob to paanu ve su.
Yom pale undarab ila atem, ve ughan ghavuur to taan ila ila le irau mateeŋ tiom.
Ve you pale naghur koi ineep ila yom ve liva sosomim.
Ve paghu tiom ve paghu toni tovene paam. Koi pale ineep ila sosodi.
Paghu to liva pale ivazag dabam ve imumi.
Ve yom pale uŋaaŋ aghe gudu.” Ro 16:20; Hib 2:14; 1Yo 3:8

content: Ghoro Maaron isaav pa liva ighaze: “You pale naghur pataŋani payom tovene: Ighaze yom apom, nene pale pataŋani tiina igham ghom. Ve sawa to ighaze upoop, yom pale uyamaan yabyabuuŋ tiina kat. Eemoghon lolom pale ineep ariaŋa ila to azuwam, ve uneep ila ye samba.”

Ghoro Maaron isaav pa tamoot ighaze: “Yom ulooŋ azuwam aliŋa, ve ughan ai anoŋa to you naŋgalsekin ghom pani. Tovenen you pale nawaghamun taan. Nepooŋam izi taan, yom pale ugham uraat tiina, ve uyamaan katin pataŋani, ghoro ughita anoŋa.
Pasa, su samsamia ve waar mata mata pale titub tiza ve tiwaghamun uum tiom. Eemoghon yom pale ughan ila uum tonanan.

Tovenen yom pale urab taum pa uraat le ughun wadedeŋam, ghoro ughita uraat tiom anoŋa ve ughan. Ve pataŋani tovene pale ikiskis ghom le irau mateeŋ tiom. Pasa, you nagharaat ghom pa taan. Tovenen yom pale umuul ula unum taan.” Mbo 90:3; Hib 9:27
Tamoot iwaat azuwa iza Eva. Pasa, ye pale inim ival tisob to tineep izi taan ne tinandi.
Muri ghoro, Maaron Yoova igharaat ŋgai uli inim nonogiiŋa pa Adam yesuru azuwa, ve indud di pani.
Maaron indiir tamtoghon pa uum Eden

Ghoro Maaron Yoova isaav ighaze: “Laak. Tamtoghon ŋgar todi ivot inimale iit, ve tighilaal ŋgar poia ve ŋgar samia wa. [Tovenen iit irau tapul di tineep uum tonene muul maau.] Pasa, ighaze nimadi ila pa ai to igham di tineep matadi iyaryaar ne anoŋa ve tighani paam, nene pale tineep tovene itaghoni taghoni gha ila.”
Tovenen Maaron Yoova indiir di pa uum Eden. Leso tila tigham uraat pa taan to yesuru tivot pani.

Ye indiir di tivot tila, ghoro ighur aŋela ariaŋadi pida tila tiyoon ila uum dige to ndag iza pani. Yes tiyondyood toman buza eez to yab ighanghan ila mata ve itortoora. Leso tipoon ataam to ila pa ai to mataad iyaryaar. Syg 22:2,14
